related_sections.description: List of answer sections this diagram supports

image_tag.description: Tag to include near relevant text in answer

examples.title: PCT Timeline: Priority → Filing → National Phase
examples.alt_text: Timeline showing 12-month PCT filing deadline from priority date, followed by 30-month national phase entry deadline

content.body:
gantt
    title PCT Timeline
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Priority
    Priority Date (e.g., US Provisional) :milestone, 2026-01-01, 0d
    section PCT
    PCT Filing Window (12 months) :active, 2026-01-01, 365d
    PCT Filing Deadline :milestone, 2027-01-01, 0d
    section National Phase
    National Phase Window :active, 2027-01-01, 18M
    National Phase Entry Deadline (30 months from priority) :milestone, 2028-07-01, 0d
